title: Quick Springy Peruvian Chicken Aji De Gallina
description: A winey and springy one-pot Peruvian dish featuring red chilli, this recipe is a variation of the traditional Aji De Gallina, made with chicken instead of shredded chicken and incorporating ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced red chilli peppers and cook for 2 minutes, until slightly softened.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the white wine to the pot and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced, about 3 minutes.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream, if using, and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until heated through.
Season the dish with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped walnuts and parsley, and serve hot.
